description:
Extra System Reloaded - Oddisz Edition

WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?
- Lets you pour credits, materials and story points into the ships you love, until they are as overpowered as you can afford.
- Only your ships. Enemy fleets never get any of it.

Every friendly market with a spaceport gets an Extra Systems bay. Pick a ship, buy upgrade levels, raise its hull quality at shipyards, and slot rare augments with effects of their own.

A from-scratch remake of Extra System Reloaded for 0.98a. The code is fully open source. You don't have to credit me. Claude Code built this anyway.
Requires LunaLib.

Upgrades

13 upgrades with 10 levels each: Durability, Weapons, Targeting, Magazines, Flux Grid, Defenses (shields or phase), Engines, Ship System, Hangars, Logistics, Cargo Holds, Sensors and Conditioning.Past level 10, overclock up to 5 more levels for a story point each.Hover over any upgrade in the bay to see exactly what the next level does and what it costs.Changed your mind? Remove a level for half of what you paid, or undo anything you bought on this visit in full.

Hull quality

Every hull rolls a quality between 80% and 120%. It multiplies every upgrade on that ship.Heavy Industry and Orbital Works (and modded shipyards) can raise it, up to 200%. Each step costs more than the last.

Augments

Ten rare devices, found in salvage or fabricated at Orbital Works: Overload Damper, Nanolattice Regenerator, Cryo-Flux Exchanger, Temporal Capacitor, Phase Coil Tuner, Point Defense Integrator, Hangar Microforge, Missile Autoforge, Vent Thrusters and Fire Control Equalizer.1 slot on frigates, 2 on destroyers and cruisers, 3 on capitals. Removing an augment gives it back.

Paying

Credits, materials from your cargo and storage, or Industrial Evolution ship and relic components if you play with IndEvo.Shipyards and your own colonies give discounts.

Settings

In LunaLib's settings menu (Shift+F2 in the campaign): maximum level, overclocking, upgrade strength, hull quality range, augment slots and every price.

FAQ

Can I add it to an existing save?

Yes.

Can I remove it from a save?

Not once a ship has been upgraded: upgraded ships carry its hidden hull mod.

Does it work with Exotica Technologies?

Yes. They do not share anything.

[close]CreditsThe idea comes from

Extra System

by Originem and

Extra System Reloaded

by Iridescens and President Matt Damon. This is a new mod written from scratch; none of their code or art is used.

[close]
